user.title: Connect Hospitable
user.description: Enter a Read-only Personal Access Token from Hospitable → Apps → API access. Your token stays on this Home Assistant instance.

timezone.title: Confirm property timezone
timezone.description: Property: {property}. API reports {reported_timezone}. Select this property's IANA timezone; the suggested Home Assistant timezone may differ.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew Hospitable token
reauth_confirm.description: Create a new Read-only PAT for the same account.

error.invalid_auth: Token invalid, expired, or missing Read permission.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Check connectivity and retry after any API rate limit.
error.select_properties: Select at least one available property.
error.wrong_account: This token cannot read all configured properties.

abort.no_properties: No properties are available to this token.

settings.title: Timing and privacy
settings.description: Guest details are off by default. Enabling them exposes guest names and contacts in state attributes and Recorder history. Disabling stops future exposure; existing history remains until purged.

data.guest_details: Expose guest names and contact details

cloud_required.title: Polling mode
cloud_required.description: Push updates need Home Assistant Cloud (Nabu Casa). The integration is working in polling mode, with updates every {minutes} minutes.

enable_push.title: Enable push updates
enable_push.description: Enter the primary Hospitable account email. Hospitable derives host signing secrets from this email encoded in base64. This is not a strong random signing secret; protect the hook URL too. Anyone with the URL can post to it, which is why signature verification matters.

webhook_status.title: Webhook status

test_event.title: Send test event
test_event.description: Submit to send a signed synthetic event through the local registered receiver. This checks signatures and processing. It does not test cloud routing or Hospitable registration.

disable_push.title: Disable push updates
disable_push.description: Delete the Nabu Casa hook and continue polling. Remove the corresponding webhook in Hospitable as well.

error.cloud_unavailable: Home Assistant Cloud is unavailable. Check its subscription and connection, then retry.
error.invalid_email: Enter the primary account email address.

invalid_auth.title: Hospitable token needs renewal
invalid_auth.description: The token is invalid, expired, or missing Read permission. Continue to start reauthentication.

confirm.title: Renew token
confirm.description: Continue to start the integration's reauthentication flow.
